title: Case III Cross-Shaped Object and Case IV Lighted Cigar-Shaped Object with Exhaust
description: Two shaded illustrations. At the top is a cross-shaped object formed by two rounded cylinders, which appears to illustrate the winged, cigar-bodied object of Case III. At the bottom is an elongated cigar-shaped object labeled "Lighted" with a streaming plume labeled "Exhaust". The text between them describes Case IV (Serial 4599.00): two cigar-shaped objects seen at midnight on July 19, 1952 by people curing tobacco, described as transparent and lit from inside (page 80).
